explanation: Rechecking confirms I fails: its mixed partials are x^3 and y^3, unequal throughout any nonempty open set. II is realized by f=e^(x+y)−2xy. III is realized by f=(2/3)(x−1)^(3/2)−3y on x>1, with continuous second derivatives. Thus II and III only is correct, agreeing with the revealed solution.
